knowledge:
- key_parameters: localpath=directory containing input <samplename>.positions.csv files ;; sampNames=character vector of sample names ;; convrates=bisulfite conversion rates per sample (1 - pplus) ;; is.reference=logical vector indicating reference (TRUE) vs single-cell samples (FALSE) ;; pminus=false negative rate (fraction of methylated counts falsely called as unmethylated, default 0.2) ;; regionSize=size of genomic regions to pool CpG positions (default 10000) ;; minCounts=minimum read count threshold for a region to be retained (default 5) ;; computeRegions=logical, whether to recompute regions from positional input ;; computeMatrices=logical, whether to recompute model data from regions ;; writeEpicallMatrix=logical, whether to write epimutation calling output as CSV matrices
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation for the downstream modeling and epimutation calling steps
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing single-cell bisulfite sequencing (BS-Seq) data to identify regional epimutations (methylation changes) relative to a reference multi-cell sample, especially when dealing with low-coverage data that requires pooling and bias correction for incomplete bisulfite conversion and sequencing errors
- pitfalls: In single-cell samples, multiple reads covering one CpG position are highly dependent due to low template DNA amount (at most two strands); treating them as independent (like in multi-cell samples) is a mistake, so BEAT combines multiple counts at one position to a single call. Incomplete bisulfite conversion (false positives, pplus) and sequencing/mapping errors (false negatives, pminus) must be carefully estimated and specified, otherwise methylation estimates will be biased. Regions with counts below minCounts must be filtered out to avoid unreliable downstream analysis. Input CSV files must follow a strict naming convention (<samplename>.positions.csv) and column structure (chr, pos, meth, unmeth).

workflows.name: single_cell_epimutation_analysis
workflows.intent: Quantify DNA methylation and call regional epimutations from single-cell bisulfite sequencing data compared to a reference sample.
input: reference.positions.csv (CSV file containing columns chr, pos, meth, unmeth for the reference sample)
sample.positions.csv (CSV file containing columns chr, pos, meth, unmeth for the single-cell sample)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the package and define the local path and sample parameters using makeParams ;; 2. Pool individual CpG counts into genomic regions using positions_to_regions ;; 3. Model regional methylation rates and correct for experimental biases using generate_results ;; 4. Call methylating and demethylating epimutations using epimutation_calls
workflows.code:
library(BEAT)
localpath <- system.file('extdata', package = 'BEAT')
positions <- read.csv(file.path(localpath, "sample.positions.csv"))
head(positions)
sampNames <- c('reference','sample')
sampNames
is.reference <- c(TRUE, FALSE)
pplus <- c(0.2, 0.5)
convrates <- 1 - pplus
params <- makeParams(localpath, sampNames, convrates, is.reference, pminus = 0.2, regionSize = 10000, minCounts = 5)
params
positions_to_regions(params)
generate_results(params)
epiCalls <- epimutation_calls(params)
head(epiCalls$methSites$singlecell,3)
head(epiCalls$demethSites$singlecell,3)
